prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile UI proposal for the Vehicle & documents page in Rakky Ride, for user approval before implementation.
Primary request: one complete polished portrait app screen, approximately 403 x 850 logical pixels at high resolution. Match the compact small-type white/mint/forest-green design of the supplied fictional driver-trip reference, but adapt the content to vehicle and submitted documents. White background, charcoal #141A14 text, forest green #176B17, pale mint #EAF5E5, silver #EEF1EC, fine silver borders. Shared app typography at logical sizes: header 15px medium, body and helpers 13px, section headers 14px medium. Small conventional outline utility icons 16–18px. Avoid oversized fonts, tall controls or large gaps. Actions have 44px minimum touch zones. No photographic background, no phone hardware frame, no map, no decorative gradients. All displayed vehicle information is fictional sample content.

Composition: top narrow status bar, then compact header with 44px silver circular back arrow and title "Vehicle & documents" on a single line. No subtitle in header.

Vehicle summary: rounded mint card with a SMALL clean stylized 3D green generic sedan illustration, not photorealistic, about 64px logical wide, left of vehicle title "Toyota Corolla" (15px medium) and small muted subline "2021 · Silver". The illustration is a generic service illustration rather than a claim about the vehicle's color. Below a fine divider, tidy two-column details: label "Plate number" above "LAG 123 XY", label "Category" above "Car". At bottom of this compact card, small green textual status pill with tiny check: "Application approved". This pill refers only to the overall application.

Next row: section title "Submitted documents", far right tiny muted "3 of 3 uploaded".
Then a single compact rounded white bordered group of THREE rows, each 60px tall with fine hairline separators, left small consistent dark/green outline icon in 30px silver rounded square, middle title, right small green pill literally "Uploaded":
"Driving licence" with ID-card outline icon;
"Vehicle registration" with document outline icon;
"Insurance" with shield outline icon.
These rows are information only: NO chevrons, NO View/Edit/Download/Replace controls.
Below a subtle silver informational strip with small info icon and TWO very concise small-text sentences: "Uploaded files are on record." and "Validity and expiry are not shown here." No claim that uploaded documents are verified, valid or up to date.

Below, a white grouped navigation card with exactly TWO compact rows, each small outline icon left and chevron right:
"Application status" (small checklist/file icon);
"Service applications" (small car/package outline icon), with smaller muted subline "Ride and courier reviewed separately".
Then a modest bottom support section: tiny header "Need to update your details?", one-line helper "Contact support for reviewed documents.", followed by a full-width forest green button with small headset icon and white compact label "Contact support". Keep clear bottom safe area and fit the ENTIRE page without clipping any section.

Constraints: all names and plate numbers above are sample data. The only reference supplied is a fictional app design, not a live private account screenshot. Do not show driver's licence numbers, private document thumbnails, expiry dates, upload dates, vehicle replacement, automatic renewal, per-document Verified badges, unexplained warning alerts, a big brand logo, or unsupported actions. Compact balanced vehicle/documents management page with beautiful alignment and no excessive words. Reference image is for typography, card geometry and palette only; do not copy trip history data or filters.

Refine this Vehicle & documents mobile design. Keep the document group, information strip, navigation rows, wording, colors and support button exactly as they are. Make only the vehicle summary card more compact: reduce its total height to about 150 logical pixels in a 403px wide screen; use a SMALL generic rounded stylized 3D green sedan, with simple smooth clay-like surfaces, no real manufacturer badge, no photorealistic grille or textures, only 60 logical pixels wide and 36 high, to the left of Toyota Corolla / 2021 · Silver. Vehicle details stay two columns below a thin divider. Make 'Application approved' a small left-aligned status pill rather than a full-width bar. Preserve all text and all three documents and both navigation actions. Shift subsequent sections upward to use the saved space, keep everything compact and balanced with a clear bottom safe area. This is the complete entire app screen, not a cropped card. Keep text small (13–15 logical px). No phone hardware frame. No new features. The car is a generic illustration.
